parts.latex: Joseph is collecting data from people exiting a coffee shop. He is recording the size of the coffee each person has ordered. This is an example of:

solutions.latex:
The size of a coffee (for example small, medium, large) is a category, not a measured number, so the data is categorical.

The sizes can be put in a natural order (small $<$ medium $<$ large), so the data is ordinal rather than nominal.

Hence the data is categorical ordinal data (option B).

meta.self_check: Classification of data type: categories with a natural order are ordinal; matches key B.
